reason: Two blocker-class security holes (committed live keys, unauthenticated paid AI endpoint) plus a mobile blocker mean this is a strong single-user demo but not deployable or sellable yet.
topFix: Rotate keys, gate /api/ai-lookup server-side, fix mobile scan layout.

reason: Desktop reads clearly in under 10 seconds, but the 'Saved: 0 while rows say Synced' counter looks like a bug, provider-name jargon leaks, and Products page has no search at scale.
topFix: Fix the Saved counter contradiction and strip internal AI/provider jargon from all user-facing screens.

reason: Live API keys committed to git history (three commits), unauthenticated POST to a paid AI pipeline, client-side-only spend cap, undici CVEs, and DNS-blind SSRF guard.
topFix: Rotate exposed keys, scrub git history, add server-side auth + rate limit + spend cap on /api/ai-lookup.

reason: Role gating is UI-only; the full alias/catalog DB and raw codes sit in the Zustand store and global catalogEntries is readable by any signed-in user, so devtools or direct Firestore reads expose everything.
topFix: Implement the deferred server-side customer resolution endpoint so customer browsers never receive raw codes or the catalog DB.

reason: businessId is taken from the request body; the membership check exists but the no-Firebase/emulator fallback is unaudited and there is no integration test proving cross-tenant access is blocked. NEXT_PUBLIC_OPEN_ACCESS can bypass the whole auth guard.
topFix: Validate authenticated uid against requested businessId server-side and add a cross-tenant denial integration test.

reason: Session/export/import controls bury scan feedback below the fold at 390px, the feed table truncates Status and Saved columns, and the scan box is not auto-focused on load.
topFix: Collapse session controls into one row and put the scan input plus last-scan confirmation first on mobile.

reason: Auto-focus-after-submit works and friction is low, but the input is not focused on initial load, the placeholder says 'Click here' which misleads, and a same-weight unconfirmed Delete sits next to Modify in count rows.
topFix: Auto-focus on page load, fix placeholder copy, and demote/confirm the Delete action.

reason: No correctness defects were surfaced in this finding set; the Gemini-first then ChatGPT pipeline with app-side evidence verification is the documented design. Lower than full only due to lack of fresh accuracy proof in these reports.
topFix: Add a current decode accuracy proof run to confirm the master baseline still holds.

reason: Internal fields (verifiedFacts, guesses, confidence, autoVerifyScore) leak to customer roles, the name is jargon-heavy, and a missing 'Correct' button suggests the in-row correction path may be absent or renamed.
topFix: Wrap internal AI fields in the isPlatform guard and rename 'Needs Review' to plain language like 'Unrecognized items'.

reason: The daily spend cap lives only in client Zustand state; a direct HTTP POST bypasses it entirely, the endpoint is unauthenticated, and a flood test ran 3,318 requests with zero 429s.
topFix: Enforce the daily cap and rate limit server-side with a persistent counter and return 429 when exceeded.

reason: Offline-tolerant scan, pending sync queue, retry, and idempotency are documented and built; the only related concern is the always-visible 'Try saving again' button on the happy path. No offline defects surfaced.
topFix: Hide the retry button unless a sync is actually pending or failed.

reason: Only the final-counts CSV is wired; products, aliases, raw scan log, and unknowns exports are absent, there is no bulk product import or part-number-only onboarding, and export role gating is not live.
topFix: Wire the missing exports (raw log, unknowns, products, aliases) and add a products CSV import for cold-start onboarding.

reason: Strong core (fast idempotent offline count with AI decode) but missing the features that make it a recurring paid product: per-user attribution, session history/compare, product search, low-stock alerts, and an audit viewer.
topFix: Ship product search and session history first; they convert a one-time tool into a recurring subscription workflow.

reason: No pricing model was tested in these findings; confidence is dragged down by the lack of role tiers, missing exports, and cold-start problem that all weaken what can be charged for today.
topFix: Lock the role model and recurring features (session history, low-stock) so a clear paid tier exists to price.

reason: Per the provided signal: Tekmetric Tire Suite adds tire inventory for $39/month on a platform shops already trust, and Sortly/inFlow/Lightspeed beat us on preloaded catalogs, multi-format export, role tiers, and PO/reorder workflows.
topFix: Position as the offline-tolerant count layer that exports cleanly into Tekmetric, and close the catalog-import and export gaps.

reason: Audit events are written but have no UI viewer, there is no per-user attribution to investigate discrepancies, no .env.example for onboarding, and jargon-heavy copy drives support questions.
topFix: Surface the existing audit log in a manager-only viewer and add per-user scan attribution.
